owner: CC owns the harness, the declaration requirement and the proofs. A finding

questions.a: THE ESTABLISHED NAME IS MUTATION TESTING, and it is called that here. Build-to-the-tool naming: a term must be derivable from its native-domain use, and nobody should have to memorise a local synonym for a known technique. Naming it correctly also carries information — it means the shape is known-good rather than a local guess.

THE TWO MUTATIONS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE, and this is the finding worth the ticket. If mutating side A reds and mutating side B does not, the check is a one-input check wearing an agreement check's clothes — precisely the shape this session set out to eliminate. That diagnosis is more valuable than the pass/fail, and it is only available because the mutation set is exactly two.

MUTATE THE INPUTS, NOT THE CHECKER. Mutating the checker tests the harness. It is the easy wrong version and is written into the falsifier because it would look like working code and produce confident, meaningless greens.

AN UNMUTATABLE INPUT IS RECORDED, NEVER SKIPPED. A silent skip lets coverage read as total while the covered set shrinks — the same no-data-is-not-a-pass shape that runs through the whole corrosion program.

watchme.as_cast_verbatim: PROBE at cairn/machines/corrosion/probes/mutation_catches_a_real_one.py — fires when mutation has run over every declared agreement check 10+ times and never found a half-dead or vacuous one; clears when it has found at least one REAL vacuous or half-dead check in the live corpus, not the fixture.
watchme.trigger: mutation has run over every declared agreement check in the corpus at least 10 times and has never once found a half-dead or fully vacuous check — either a genuinely sound corpus or an instrument that cannot fail, and a green that has never been red cannot tell you which. The never-redded signal, applied to the instrument built to detect it
watchme.enough: cleared when mutation has found at least one REAL vacuous or half-dead check in the live corpus — not the fixture, which proves only that the harness works. The claim being tested is that vacuous checks exist here and this finds them, and only a live catch settles it
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the count of declared agreement checks, how many were mutated, how many were unmutatable and why, and every half-dead finding with the side named
watchme.consumer: CC as owner; Akien on a finding, since a vacuous check means something believed proved was not

dependencies: AN AGREEMENT CHECK MUST DECLARE ITS TWO SIDES. This is real design cost and was absent from the first pass: inferring which checks are agreement checks by inspecting code would be a vacuous instrument for detecting vacuous instruments.

HONEST ABOUT n: the corpus holds a small and uncounted number of true agreement checks today — orient's provenance measurement is one, the charter-claim check will be another. The instrument may land at n=2, so 'it works' will be a weaker claim than it sounds, which is why the watch requires a catch in the LIVE corpus rather than in a fixture.
OPEN AT CAST: whether mutation is cheap enough to run on every proof, or whether it is a separate pass.
filed_edges: MUTATION PROVES A CHECK CAN RED; IT DOES NOT PROVE THE CHECK IS ASKING THE RIGHT QUESTION. A check comparing two wrong things reds correctly under both mutations and passes this instrument cleanly. That is the semantic half, and it is exactly what the corrosion program routes to the LLM pass rather than to a deterministic check — noted here so the green this harness emits is not read as more than it is.

ONE-INPUT CHECKS ARE OUT OF SCOPE AND ARE THE MAJORITY OF THE CORPUS. This instrument only grips a shape most existing checks do not have, so its coverage will be small for a long time and will grow only as checks are rewritten as agreements. Whether that rewrite is worth doing broadly is a design question nobody has asked yet.

superseded_by.why: mutation testing is one sieve in a broader code-watching capability. CodeMother watches the codebase for failure modes (papering over, half-dead checks, intention drift) driven by inference_proxy. The agreement-check harness is a capability of that device, not its own ticket.
what_transfers: the mutation harness design (corrupt side A, corrupt side B, name which)
the filed_edges (semantic half routes to LLM, one-input checks out of scope)
